action_instruction: Reading the shipment timeline step sequence
intent: the ordered sequence of step titles in the shipment timeline

action_params.condition: The timeline lists the steps "Ordered", "Shipped", "Out for delivery" and "Delivered" in that order.
action_params.query: the ordered sequence of step titles in the shipment timeline
action_params.expected_value: Ordered | Shipped | Out for delivery | Delivered

output_value: Ordered | Shipped | Out for delivery | Delivered

action_instruction: Checking the completion state of the Ordered step
intent: whether the Ordered shipment step is marked complete

action_params.query: whether the Ordered shipment step is marked complete

action_instruction: Reading the Shipped step date and time
intent: the displayed date and time of the Shipped shipment step

action_params.condition: The "Shipped" step shows the date "Sunday, September 13, 2026 · 6:40 PM".
action_params.query: the displayed date and time of the Shipped shipment step

assertion_tree.description: The timeline lists the steps "Ordered", "Shipped", "Out for delivery" and "Delivered" in that order, "Ordered" is marked complete, and the "Shipped" step shows the date "Sunday, September 13, 2026 · 6:40 PM".

sub_results.description: The timeline lists the steps "Ordered", "Shipped", "Out for delivery" and "Delivered" in that order.
sub_results.expected: Ordered | Shipped | Out for delivery | Delivered

variable_refs.{{timeline_steps_order_check}}: Ordered | Shipped | Out for delivery | Delivered

sub_results.description: The "Shipped" step shows the date "Sunday, September 13, 2026 · 6:40 PM".

assertion_tree.verification: The current timeline shows the specified steps in order, completion status, and Shipped date.
